requirements.description: Annual Compustat fundamentals for the SEO issuers, cross-sectional normal-level estimation cells, and size/performance-matched nonissuing firms.

required_coverage.population: United States nonfinancial Compustat annual Industrial/Research observations, including issuers and broad two-digit-SIC-year peers.
required_coverage.detail: The original SEO offer-year window is 1987–2006. The paper requires four annual statements before the filing date plus offer-year and following-year data; because filing can precede offer year, use a conservative beginning at 1982. Table 6 year-one outcomes extend through 2007. Supporting equations are same-year two-digit-SIC cross-sections, with prior-year assets/sales fields explicitly included in the raw interval.

routes.mapping_notes: Unverified: the live annual fields have labels consistent with assets, sales, gross PP&E, earnings, operating cash flow, cost of goods sold, inventories, advertising, R&D, SG&A, capital expenditures and historical SIC. The source gives historical Compustat item numbers; the #308−#124 continuing-operations cash-flow mapping and the historical product/filter equivalence are not independently established.
routes.coverage_notes: Exact resource and listed live fields were probed; the probe reads only a bounded row slice and no coordinator coverage confirmation is frozen for this batch. It cannot establish historical completeness or the required study population.

requirements.unresolved_reason: No frozen local coverage confirmation establishes complete 1982–2007 annual observations for the original issuer and peer populations; the historical item-number crosswalk for continuing-operations CFO and the exact nonfinancial/format filters also remain unresolved.

requirements.description: Completed U.S. seasoned equity issues used to form the 1,511-event original sample, including filing/offer dates, issuer identity, security and price/status details needed to apply the source exclusions.

required_coverage.population: Completed U.S. SEOs in the SDC New Issue universe; exclude the paper-listed classes, low-price offers, nondomestic issues and incomplete cases.
required_coverage.detail: The paper fixes offer years 1987–2006. Filing date is a distinct SDC date used by the four-prior-year statement filter; issue/offer date anchors the event-year outcome.

requirements.description: Identify Compustat firms with no IPO or SEO during the study period and form the size/performance-matched nonissuer benchmark for post-SEO ROA changes.

required_coverage.population: Nonfinancial Compustat firms without an IPO or SEO during the stated 1987–2006 sample period, eligible as size- and ROA-matched issuer benchmarks.
required_coverage.detail: The Table 6 adjustment uses a nonissuer whose assets are within 90–110% of the issuer at the fiscal year before offering and whose ROA is closest; the issuer and match changes are observed through year one. SDC history must screen the entire study period.

variable_coverage.construction: TA_{it}/Assets_{i,t−1}: Total accruals scaled by total assets at t−1. Total accruals are EBXI (Compustat annual item 123; earnings before extraordinary items and discontinued operations) less CFO from continuing operations (Compustat annual item 308 less item 124). Source formula: TA_{it}/Assets_{i,t−1}. Raw resource mapped to COMP.FUNDA annual fields listed in R-COMP-ANNUAL; exact historical item-number mapping remains as described in the requirement.

1 / Assets_{i,t−1}: Inverse of prior-year total assets (Compustat annual item 6). Source formula: 1 / Assets_{i,t−1}. Raw resource mapped to COMP.FUNDA annual fields listed in R-COMP-ANNUAL; exact historical item-number mapping remains as described in the requirement.

ΔSALES_{it} / Assets_{i,t−1}: Change in revenues from t−1 to t (Compustat annual item 12), scaled by prior-year total assets (item 6). Source formula: ΔSALES_{it} / Assets_{i,t−1}. Raw resource mapped to COMP.FUNDA annual fields listed in R-COMP-ANNUAL; exact historical item-number mapping remains as described in the requirement.

PPE_{it} / Assets_{i,t−1}: Gross property, plant and equipment (Compustat annual item 7), scaled by prior-year total assets (item 6). Source formula: PPE_{it} / Assets_{i,t−1}. Raw resource mapped to COMP.FUNDA annual fields listed in R-COMP-ANNUAL; exact historical item-number mapping remains as described in the requirement.

DROA1: First difference in annual ROA in year 1 after the SEO, adjusted by subtracting the change in ROA of a size- and performance-matched nonissuing firm. ROA is income before extraordinary items divided by beginning-of-period total assets. Source formula: ΔROA_{issuer,year 1} − ΔROA_{matched nonissuer,year 1}. Raw resource mapped to COMP.FUNDA annual fields listed in R-COMP-ANNUAL; exact historical item-number mapping remains as described in the requirement.

Discretionary accruals: Year-0 (SEO-year) discretionary accruals. DA is total accruals scaled by assets at t−1 less fitted normal accruals from Eq. (1). Total accruals are Compustat 123 earnings before extraordinary items and discontinued operations minus operating cash flows from continuing operations, Compustat 308 less 124. The normal-accrual fit uses the displayed scaled constant, change in revenue, and gross PPE, each divided by lagged assets. Source formula: (TA_{it}/Assets_{i,t−1}) − [k̂1/Assets_{i,t−1} + k̂2·ΔSALES_{it}/Assets_{i,t−1} + k̂3·PPE_{it}/Assets_{i,t−1}]. Raw resource mapped to COMP.FUNDA annual fields listed in R-COMP-ANNUAL; exact historical item-number mapping remains as described in the requirement.

Sales growth: Growth in sales in the year of the SEO, included as a year-0 control in Table 6. The paper does not report its arithmetic formula or data-item definition. Source formula: not reported in the source. Raw resource mapped to COMP.FUNDA annual fields listed in R-COMP-ANNUAL; exact historical item-number mapping remains as described in the requirement.

Capex growth: Growth in capital expenditures in the year of the SEO, included as a year-0 control in Table 6. The paper does not report its arithmetic formula or data-item definition. Source formula: not reported in the source. Raw resource mapped to COMP.FUNDA annual fields listed in R-COMP-ANNUAL; exact historical item-number mapping remains as described in the requirement.

design_coverage.reason: The baseline reports annual cross-sectional Fama–MacBeth regressions and the supporting residual equations fit within 2-digit SIC-year cells; no dummy fixed-effect family is specified.
The source reports Fama–MacBeth inference for the baseline Table 6 regressions and does not specify cluster-robust standard errors.
No weighting variable or weighted-regression procedure is reported for these baseline regressions.

implementation_issues.description: The annual cross-sectional baseline table does not name the within-year estimator used to produce its coefficients; Fama–MacBeth averaging/inference is stated but the row-level estimator remains unresolved.
Table 6 includes sales growth and capex growth controls, but the source does not define formulas, comparison periods, denominators or fiscal-year alignment.

evidence.description: The source describes a completed United States seasoned equity offering sample over this period.
The sample filter requires four preceding annual statements relative to the filing date, the offer year and the following year.
The annual industry-year normal-level fits use two-digit SIC groupings and impose a minimum cell size of eight.
Table 6 uses year-zero earnings-management variables to explain post-offer ROA changes; the selected fit is the year-one outcome.
For the post-offer performance adjustment, nonissuing firms are selected using an asset-size band around the issuer and closest ROA.
